vite_missing: mod:install inertia needs a Vite config. Add the @modules alias and module views to your refresh paths manually.
vite_custom: mod:install inertia does not recognize [%s]. Add the @modules alias to [%s] and refresh path [%s] manually.
vite_description: the @modules alias, module views in refresh paths
typescript_custom: mod:install inertia does not recognize [tsconfig.json]. Add "@modules/*": ["./%s/*"] to paths and "%s" to include manually.
tailwind_missing: mod:install inertia needs Tailwind wiring. Add @source "%s" to your Tailwind v4 CSS entry, or the module glob to Tailwind v3 content.
